description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData' which implements the 'ReportData' interface. The class is responsible for providing report data related to employee leave entitlements and usage, including normalization of data and meta information. It interacts with leave entitlement services, employee services, and utilizes helper traits for date, number, and internationalization functions. The class constructs report data with details like leave types, balances, and URLs for detailed views.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: Implements report data retrieval for employee leave entitlements and usage, providing normalized report data and metadata for a human resource management system.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a normalized array of leave entitlement and usage data per leave type for a specific employee within specified date range, including URLs for detailed views.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns additional metadata about the report, including total leave types count and employee details as an array.
